classification: Independent automated controller-driven playability review. This is not literal human hands-on testing.
limitations: The review exercises the scoped B01 Right/B/Start+C path; it does not claim full campaign controls, accessibility, or balance.
Input is automated through the real configured controller path; no person physically held a controller in these sessions.
Still screenshots support readability review but are not video.
Audio is assessed by the separate M4 audio gate.

observations.evidence: Owned window-key events reached a standard gamepad3.1: Right moved current from X=32 to X=108, B was observed as an edge, and Start+C performed the documented manual commit.
Start+C changed attempt 0/tick 40 directly to attempt 1/tick 0 without consuming an authoritative replay byte; the live renderer exposed RESET_ACTIVE with a visible RESET TRACE.
The physical echo stopped at X=80 with occupancy bit 0 while current advanced to X=152; the door changed 0->3 and the frame said DOOR OPEN / ECHO HOLDS.
In a fresh zero-echo run, Right+B left current colliding at X=108, engine active, result OK, door closed, and terminal unset; the HUD explicitly said DOOR CLOSED / NEED ECHO.
The blocked run accepted Start+C and reconstructed attempt 1/tick 0 at canonical X=32 with one echo, no engine error, and a new current replay bank.
Right x32 + neutral x8 was read back from bank 6 with CRC 96501AB7; bank 6 became echo ordinal 1, bank 0 current, and the solution reached PROGRAM STABLE at tick 166.
